tool_signatures.name: cancelOrder
tool_signatures.description:
Cancels one or more open Hyperliquid orders using a pre-signed EIP-712
cancellation payload. Supports batch cancellation of up to 50 order IDs.
Scout capacity is available inside the shared 30 requests / 24h quota; Pioneer is capped at 1,500/day and Syndicate at 50,000/day. After the Scout quota, the default x402 overage is $0.01 USDC for one additional API call. Commercial capacity never supplies venue authority: every
cancellation request must include a fresh EIP-712 signature from the
user's Hyperliquid API wallet. For delegated signing, `accountAddress`
identifies the venue-verified equity owner. A subaccount/vault owner is
incorporated as `vaultAddress` in both the signature hash and exchange
request. FarmDash recovers the exact signer before submission. Required
`expiresAt` is forwarded as
Hyperliquid `expiresAfter`; required `intentHash` binds the FarmDash
request for auditability. HTTP 202 is returned only when Hyperliquid
supplies one explicit `success` application status per requested order;
this is `accepted` application acknowledgement, not final venue cancellation.
Mixed or total application errors are rejections. Reconcile every requested
ID through `/api/v1/agent/futures/reconcile-order` before dependent action.
Venue nonce authority is `network + signer + nonce` across account and vault
contexts. Durable replay control fails closed before submission.
WARNING: Real market actions can cause financial loss. USER_SIGNED requires fresh manual approval for each order/cancel. BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS permits local agent signing without per-order confirmation only under a valid explicit owner-signed futures grant, authenticated session, venue delegation and all applicable gates. Read x-farmdash-capability-truth and live domain readiness; preparation or payment alone never authorizes dispatch.

Owner registration permanently enrolls the API wallet on its network across accounts, including after expiry/revocation; stripping mode/session fields cannot bypass bounded policy. Bounded dispatch returns nonretryable bounded_futures_preparation_only while rollout is not operational.

tool_signatures.name: createQuoteIntent
tool_signatures.description:
Explicit execution intent. Requires exact chain pair, token pair,
amount, real wallet/taker, destination, slippage, and a client
idempotency key; the fee tier is resolved server-side before any
provider call. One intent contacts exactly one primary provider; a
sequential alternate follows only a genuine primary failure.
Identical intents reuse the stored firm quote (HTTP 200 reused:true);
changed parameters never reuse a stale quote. The firm quote flows
through simulate, approval, and prepare without further provider
quote requests. Quote is not execution; FarmDash never signs or
broadcasts.

tool_signatures.name: executeOrder
tool_signatures.description:
Forwards a pre-signed EIP-712 order to Hyperliquid's exchange API.
Requires an execution-ready analyze-strategy call within 60 seconds. The
gate binds market, side, maximum size, 50 bps entry drift, maximum
analyzed leverage metadata, stop-derived risk, and the account whose
equity funded the sizing decision. `funding_arb` remains
analysis-only because this endpoint cannot atomically bind both legs.
Scout capacity is available inside the shared 30 requests / 24h quota; Pioneer is capped at 1,500/day and Syndicate at 50,000/day. After the Scout quota, the default x402 overage is $0.01 USDC for one additional API call. Commercial capacity never supplies venue authority: every request
must also include a fresh EIP-712 signature from the user's
Hyperliquid API wallet. All risk
guardrails enforced server-side before forwarding. `nonce`, `expiresAt`,
and `intentHash` are required for request-scoped expiry and auditability.
Venue nonce authority is `network + signer + nonce` across account and vault
contexts. Durable replay control fails closed before submission.
`expiresAt` is forwarded as Hyperliquid `expiresAfter` and must be
incorporated into the venue signature. The signed order action contains
the FarmDash builder term `f=1`, meaning 0.1 basis point (0.001%) of
filled notional—not 1 bp. The user must approve that builder fee on
Hyperliquid before execution. Rejected/resting/unfilled notional is not
reported as fee-bearing volume. FarmDash recovers the signer from the
exact signed L1 payload and rejects any mismatch with `agentAddress`.
When the verified owner is a Hyperliquid subaccount or vault,
`accountAddress` is also incorporated as the signed and submitted
`vaultAddress`; it cannot be changed after signing.
It also preflights the account owner's Hyperliquid `maxBuilderFee` and
blocks when the approved maximum is below `f=1`; only the main account
wallet, not an API wallet, can sign that approval action.
WARNING: Real market actions can cause financial loss. USER_SIGNED requires fresh manual approval for each order/cancel. BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS permits local agent signing without per-order confirmation only under a valid explicit owner-signed futures grant, authenticated session, venue delegation and all applicable gates. Read x-farmdash-capability-truth and live domain readiness; preparation or payment alone never authorizes dispatch.

tool_signatures.name: executeSwap
tool_signatures.description:
Main swap router. Requires a fresh successful simulationId, authenticates
the agent via EIP-191 signature, reuses the simulated quote intent, applies
Execution Alpha routing, and enforces Risk Sentinel guardrails before
returning ready-to-broadcast transaction calldata.

FarmDash does not broadcast the returned compatibility-swap transaction. FarmDash prepares
the transaction calldata for the user or agent wallet to broadcast. Automatic routing dynamically
selects across active providers (LI.FI, Relay; 0x paused until reinstated).
The FarmDash treasury receives the fee haircut directly from the protocol.

**Signing**: The agent must sign the deterministic payload:
`v1:FARMDASH_SWAP:{fromChainId}:{toChainId}:{fromToken}:{toToken}:{fromAmount}:{agentAddress}:{toAddress}:{nonce}`
using EIP-191 personal_sign. Nonce must be current timestamp (within 60s).

tool_signatures.name: getAccountState
tool_signatures.description:
Returns the agent's current positions, margin summary, equity,
unrealized PnL, liquidation prices, and risk management state.
Daily/weekly values are conservative loss-pressure metrics: rolling
closed PnL minus absolute fill fees plus funding and negative current
unrealized PnL only. Positive open gains cannot mask a realized-loss
breach; these fields are not full period-return calculations.
`agentAddress` identifies the API signer/FarmDash caller. For a
delegated API wallet, `accountAddress` must identify the Hyperliquid
master or subaccount that actually owns the equity and positions. Omit
`accountAddress` only when the signer directly owns the account. It does not require a private key or seed phrase. The
signer/owner relationship is verified against Hyperliquid `userRole`.

tool_signatures.name: getSwapQuote
tool_signatures.description:
Provider-neutral market estimate by default: returns an explicitly
labelled `market_estimate` (reference price, approximate output,
server fee tier, route compatibility, freshness) WITHOUT calling 0x,
LI.FI, or Relay trading APIs. Browsing, polling, previews, and
wallet-supplied GETs all receive estimation — a `walletAddress` alone
is exploratory context, never execution intent, and never fans out
into provider APIs. The estimate is intelligence, not a provider
quote: no executable calldata, no provider attribution, no liquidity
confirmation, never `executionReady: true`.
For execution, POST `/v1/agent/quote-intent` with exact parameters, a
real wallet, and an idempotency key to receive a firm single-provider
quote bound to an `intentId`; then re-call this endpoint with the
identical parameters plus `intentId` to serve the stored firm quote
with zero new provider calls. Changed parameters never reuse a stale
quote (`intent_params_changed`); unknown/expired intents return
`intent_not_found`. One intent contacts exactly one primary provider;
a sequential alternate follows only a genuine primary failure.
`mock=true` is not supported and returns a typed 400 without contacting a provider.

an order. Durable order/fill evidence uses the existing idempotent accounting
path; balances are not execution evidence. agentAddress is the venue API-wallet
signer, not the session agent. accountAddress identifies its delegated owner.
